theory_html:
A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 183: Write a sentence for each picture. Use going to + a phrasal verb.

Bài 183: Viết một câu cho mỗi tranh. Dùng going to + cụm động từ.

Exercise 184: Complete each sentence with a preposition.

Bài 184: Hoàn thành mỗi câu với một giới từ.

Exercise 185: Complete each sentence with the correct form of get + one of the words from the box (away, back, by, in, on, out). Use one of the words twice.

Bài 185: Hoàn thành mỗi câu với dạng đúng của get + một từ trong khung (away, back, by, in, on, out). Một từ dùng hai lần.

Exercise 186: Complete each sentence with the correct form of take + one of the words from the box (away, down, in, off, up). Use two of the words twice.

Bài 186: Hoàn thành mỗi câu với dạng đúng của take + một từ trong khung (away, down, in, off, up). Hai từ dùng hai lần.

Exercise 187: Complete each sentence with the correct form of go + one of the words from the box (away, back, in, on, out). Use two of the words twice.

Bài 187: Hoàn thành mỗi câu với dạng đúng của go + một từ trong khung (away, back, in, on, out). Hai từ dùng hai lần.

Exercise 188: Complete each sentence with the correct form of put + one of the words from the box (back, down, off, on, out). Use one of the words three times.

Bài 188: Hoàn thành mỗi câu với dạng đúng của put + một từ trong khung (back, down, off, on, out). Một từ dùng ba lần.

Exercise 189: Complete each sentence with the correct form of turn + one of the words from the box (down, off, on, out, up). Use two of the words twice.

Bài 189: Hoàn thành mỗi câu với dạng đúng của turn + một từ trong khung (down, off, on, out, up). Hai từ dùng hai lần.

Exercise 190: Complete the announcement with the verbs from the box in the correct form and the words in brackets (cross out, fill in, hand back, hand out, hold up, leave out, rub out, tear up).

Bài 190: Hoàn thành thông báo với động từ trong khung ở dạng đúng và từ trong ngoặc (cross out, fill in, hand back, hand out, hold up, leave out, rub out, tear up).

Exercise 191: Complete the newspaper article with the verbs from the box in the correct form and the words in brackets (break down, bring up, fall out with, find out, keep away, let down, put up with, run away from, show off, split up).

Bài 191: Hoàn thành bài báo với động từ trong khung ở dạng đúng và từ trong ngoặc (break down, bring up, fall out with, find out, keep away, let down, put up with, run away from, show off, split up).

B. Related units

B. Các unit liên quan

English Grammar in Use, Units 137–145 (theory below).

English Grammar in Use, Unit 137–145 (lý thuyết bên dưới).

mcq.question: I’m looking forward ___ seeing my family again.
mcq.full: I’m looking forward to seeing my family again.
mcq.vi: Tôi rất mong được gặp lại gia đình.
mcq.expl:
Phrasal verb + preposition: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Cụm động từ + giới từ: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Điểm ngữ pháp: look forward to + V-ing.
mcq.key: I’m looking forward ___ seeing my family again.|to

mcq.question: My uncle ran away ___ home when he was a teenager.
mcq.full: My uncle ran away from home when he was a teenager.
mcq.vi: Chú tôi bỏ nhà đi hồi còn thiếu niên.
mcq.expl:
Phrasal verb + preposition: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Cụm động từ + giới từ: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Điểm ngữ pháp: run away from.
mcq.key: My uncle ran away ___ home when he was a teenager.|from

mcq.question: Have you ever fallen out ___ any of your neighbours?
mcq.full: Have you ever fallen out with any of your neighbours?
mcq.vi: Bạn đã bao giờ cãi nhau với hàng xóm chưa?
mcq.expl:
Phrasal verb + preposition: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Cụm động từ + giới từ: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Điểm ngữ pháp: fall out with.
mcq.key: Have you ever fallen out ___ any of your neighbours?|with

mcq.question: How well does your brother get on ___ his classmates?
mcq.full: How well does your brother get on with his classmates?
mcq.vi: Anh trai bạn hòa hợp với bạn cùng lớp thế nào?
mcq.expl:
Phrasal verb + preposition: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Cụm động từ + giới từ: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Điểm ngữ pháp: get on with.
mcq.key: How well does your brother get on ___ his classmates?|with

mcq.question: My dentist has told me that I must cut down ___ sweets.
mcq.full: My dentist has told me that I must cut down on sweets.
mcq.vi: Nha sĩ bảo tôi phải cắt giảm đồ ngọt.
mcq.expl:
Phrasal verb + preposition: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Cụm động từ + giới từ: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Điểm ngữ pháp: cut down on.
mcq.key: My dentist has told me that I must cut down ___ sweets.|on

mcq.question: We went up ___ a woman and asked her for directions.
mcq.full: We went up to a woman and asked her for directions.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi đến gần một phụ nữ và hỏi đường.
mcq.expl:
Phrasal verb + preposition: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Cụm động từ + giới từ: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Điểm ngữ pháp: go up to.
mcq.key: We went up ___ a woman and asked her for directions.|to

mcq.question: My brother pointed his boss out ___ me as she came into the restaurant.
mcq.full: My brother pointed his boss out to me as she came into the restaurant.
mcq.vi: Anh tôi chỉ cho tôi sếp anh ấy khi bà ấy vào nhà hàng.
mcq.expl:
Phrasal verb + preposition: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Cụm động từ + giới từ: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Điểm ngữ pháp: point out to.
mcq.key: My brother pointed his boss out ___ me as she came into the restaurant.|to

mcq.question: The new manager came up ___ several interesting suggestions.
mcq.full: The new manager came up with several interesting suggestions.
mcq.vi: Quản lý mới đưa ra vài đề xuất thú vị.
mcq.expl:
Phrasal verb + preposition: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Cụm động từ + giới từ: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Điểm ngữ pháp: come up with.
mcq.key: The new manager came up ___ several interesting suggestions.|with

mcq.question: I’ll get back ___ you as soon as I’ve got any news.
mcq.full: I’ll get back to you as soon as I’ve got any news.
mcq.vi: Tôi sẽ liên lạc lại với bạn ngay khi có tin.
mcq.expl:
Phrasal verb + preposition: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Cụm động từ + giới từ: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Điểm ngữ pháp: get back to.
mcq.key: I’ll get back ___ you as soon as I’ve got any news.|to

mcq.question: My brother gets away ___ all sorts of things I wouldn’t be allowed to do.
mcq.full: My brother gets away with all sorts of things I wouldn’t be allowed to do.
mcq.vi: Anh tôi làm đủ thứ mà không bị phạt, những việc tôi không được phép làm.
mcq.expl:
Phrasal verb + preposition: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Cụm động từ + giới từ: look forward to, run away from, fall out with, get on with, cut down on, go up to, point out to, come up with, get back to, get away with.
Điểm ngữ pháp: get away with.
mcq.key: My brother gets away ___ all sorts of things I wouldn’t be allowed to do.|with

mcq.question: The taxi stopped and a man ___, holding a bunch of flowers.
mcq.full: The taxi stopped and a man got out, holding a bunch of flowers.
mcq.vi: Taxi dừng lại và một người đàn ông bước ra, tay cầm bó hoa.
mcq.expl:
get away = go on holiday; get back = return; get in = enter; get on = progress / board a bus; get by = manage with little money.
get away = đi nghỉ; get back = quay về; get in = vào; get on = tiến triển / lên xe; get by = xoay xở (với ít tiền).
Điểm ngữ pháp: get out = ra khỏi (xe).
mcq.key: The taxi stopped and a man ___, holding a bunch of flowers.|got out

mcq.question: We haven’t had a holiday yet this year. We’ve been too busy to ___.
mcq.full: We haven’t had a holiday yet this year. We’ve been too busy to get away.
mcq.vi: Năm nay chúng tôi chưa đi nghỉ. Bận quá không đi đâu được.
mcq.expl:
get away = go on holiday; get back = return; get in = enter; get on = progress / board a bus; get by = manage with little money.
get away = đi nghỉ; get back = quay về; get in = vào; get on = tiến triển / lên xe; get by = xoay xở (với ít tiền).
Điểm ngữ pháp: get away = đi nghỉ.
mcq.key: We haven’t had a holiday yet this year. We’ve been too busy to ___.|get away

mcq.question: What time do you think you’ll ___ here after the party?
mcq.full: What time do you think you’ll get back here after the party?
mcq.vi: Bạn nghĩ mấy giờ sẽ về đây sau bữa tiệc?
mcq.expl:
get away = go on holiday; get back = return; get in = enter; get on = progress / board a bus; get by = manage with little money.
get away = đi nghỉ; get back = quay về; get in = vào; get on = tiến triển / lên xe; get by = xoay xở (với ít tiền).
Điểm ngữ pháp: get back = quay về.
mcq.key: What time do you think you’ll ___ here after the party?|get back

mcq.question: The festival organisers employ security guards to prevent people ___ without tickets.
mcq.full: The festival organisers employ security guards to prevent people getting in without tickets.
mcq.vi: Ban tổ chức lễ hội thuê bảo vệ để ngăn người không có vé vào.
mcq.expl:
get away = go on holiday; get back = return; get in = enter; get on = progress / board a bus; get by = manage with little money.
get away = đi nghỉ; get back = quay về; get in = vào; get on = tiến triển / lên xe; get by = xoay xở (với ít tiền).
Điểm ngữ pháp: get in = vào.
mcq.key: The festival organisers employ security guards to prevent people ___ without tickets.|getting in

mcq.question: It’s natural for parents to wonder how their children ___ when they’re away at university.
mcq.full: It’s natural for parents to wonder how their children get on when they’re away at university.
mcq.vi: Cha mẹ băn khoăn con cái học hành sinh sống thế nào khi xa nhà học đại học là chuyện tự nhiên.
mcq.expl:
get away = go on holiday; get back = return; get in = enter; get on = progress / board a bus; get by = manage with little money.
get away = đi nghỉ; get back = quay về; get in = vào; get on = tiến triển / lên xe; get by = xoay xở (với ít tiền).
Điểm ngữ pháp: get on = tiến triển.
mcq.key: It’s natural for parents to wonder how their children ___ when they’re away at university.|get on

mcq.question: Modern buses are designed to make it easy for passengers to ___.
mcq.full: Modern buses are designed to make it easy for passengers to get on.
mcq.vi: Xe buýt hiện đại được thiết kế để hành khách dễ lên xe.
mcq.expl:
get away = go on holiday; get back = return; get in = enter; get on = progress / board a bus; get by = manage with little money.
get away = đi nghỉ; get back = quay về; get in = vào; get on = tiến triển / lên xe; get by = xoay xở (với ít tiền).
Điểm ngữ pháp: get on = lên (xe buýt).
mcq.key: Modern buses are designed to make it easy for passengers to ___.|get on

mcq.question: I don’t earn much, but I try to ___ without borrowing money from anyone.
mcq.full: I don’t earn much, but I try to get by without borrowing money from anyone.
mcq.vi: Tôi kiếm không nhiều, nhưng cố xoay xở mà không vay ai.
mcq.expl:
get away = go on holiday; get back = return; get in = enter; get on = progress / board a bus; get by = manage with little money.
get away = đi nghỉ; get back = quay về; get in = vào; get on = tiến triển / lên xe; get by = xoay xở (với ít tiền).
Điểm ngữ pháp: get by = xoay xở.
mcq.key: I don’t earn much, but I try to ___ without borrowing money from anyone.|get by

mcq.question: The woman ___ her jacket and began work.
mcq.full: The woman took off her jacket and began work.
mcq.vi: Người phụ nữ cởi áo khoác và bắt đầu làm việc.
mcq.expl:
take away = remove; be taken in = be deceived; take down = remove from a wall / window; take up = start a hobby / fill space; take off = remove clothes / leave the ground.
take away = mang đi; be taken in = bị lừa; take down = gỡ xuống; take up = bắt đầu một sở thích / chiếm chỗ; take off = cởi ra / cất cánh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: take off = cởi.
mcq.key: The woman ___ her jacket and began work.|took off

mcq.question: I had to pay £100 to have my old car ___.
mcq.full: I had to pay £100 to have my old car taken away.
mcq.vi: Tôi phải trả 100 bảng để người ta kéo chiếc xe cũ đi.
mcq.expl:
take away = remove; be taken in = be deceived; take down = remove from a wall / window; take up = start a hobby / fill space; take off = remove clothes / leave the ground.
take away = mang đi; be taken in = bị lừa; take down = gỡ xuống; take up = bắt đầu một sở thích / chiếm chỗ; take off = cởi ra / cất cánh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: take away = mang đi.
mcq.key: I had to pay £100 to have my old car ___.|taken away

mcq.question: Few of the criminals ___ by the policeman’s attempt to disguise himself as a beggar.
mcq.full: Few of the criminals were taken in by the policeman’s attempt to disguise himself as a beggar.
mcq.vi: Ít tên tội phạm bị lừa bởi màn cải trang ăn mày của viên cảnh sát.
mcq.expl:
take away = remove; be taken in = be deceived; take down = remove from a wall / window; take up = start a hobby / fill space; take off = remove clothes / leave the ground.
take away = mang đi; be taken in = bị lừa; take down = gỡ xuống; take up = bắt đầu một sở thích / chiếm chỗ; take off = cởi ra / cất cánh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be taken in = bị lừa.
mcq.key: Few of the criminals ___ by the policeman’s attempt to disguise himself as a beggar.|were taken in

mcq.question: The students were told to ___ the posters which they had hung from their windows.
mcq.full: The students were told to take down the posters which they had hung from their windows.
mcq.vi: Sinh viên được yêu cầu gỡ áp phích treo ở cửa sổ xuống.
mcq.expl:
take away = remove; be taken in = be deceived; take down = remove from a wall / window; take up = start a hobby / fill space; take off = remove clothes / leave the ground.
take away = mang đi; be taken in = bị lừa; take down = gỡ xuống; take up = bắt đầu một sở thích / chiếm chỗ; take off = cởi ra / cất cánh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: take down = gỡ xuống.
mcq.key: The students were told to ___ the posters which they had hung from their windows.|take down

mcq.question: My mother ___ yoga last year to keep herself fit.
mcq.full: My mother took up yoga last year to keep herself fit.
mcq.vi: Năm ngoái mẹ tôi bắt đầu tập yoga để giữ dáng.
mcq.expl:
take away = remove; be taken in = be deceived; take down = remove from a wall / window; take up = start a hobby / fill space; take off = remove clothes / leave the ground.
take away = mang đi; be taken in = bị lừa; take down = gỡ xuống; take up = bắt đầu một sở thích / chiếm chỗ; take off = cởi ra / cất cánh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: take up = bắt đầu (sở thích).
mcq.key: My mother ___ yoga last year to keep herself fit.|took up

mcq.question: I don’t keep a lot of music on my laptop because it ___ too much memory.
mcq.full: I don’t keep a lot of music on my laptop because it takes up too much memory.
mcq.vi: Tôi không lưu nhiều nhạc trên laptop vì nó chiếm quá nhiều bộ nhớ.
mcq.expl:
take away = remove; be taken in = be deceived; take down = remove from a wall / window; take up = start a hobby / fill space; take off = remove clothes / leave the ground.
take away = mang đi; be taken in = bị lừa; take down = gỡ xuống; take up = bắt đầu một sở thích / chiếm chỗ; take off = cởi ra / cất cánh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: take up = chiếm (chỗ).
mcq.key: I don’t keep a lot of music on my laptop because it ___ too much memory.|takes up

mcq.question: We were offered drinks soon after the plane ___.
mcq.full: We were offered drinks soon after the plane took off.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi được mời đồ uống ngay sau khi máy bay cất cánh.
mcq.expl:
take away = remove; be taken in = be deceived; take down = remove from a wall / window; take up = start a hobby / fill space; take off = remove clothes / leave the ground.
take away = mang đi; be taken in = bị lừa; take down = gỡ xuống; take up = bắt đầu một sở thích / chiếm chỗ; take off = cởi ra / cất cánh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: take off = cất cánh.
mcq.key: We were offered drinks soon after the plane ___.|took off

mcq.question: I know the house isn’t empty because I saw a man ___ about an hour ago.
mcq.full: I know the house isn’t empty because I saw a man go in about an hour ago.
mcq.vi: Tôi biết nhà có người vì khoảng một tiếng trước thấy một người đàn ông đi vào.
mcq.expl:
go in = enter; go on = happen / continue; go back = return; go away = leave home for a period; go out = stop shining / leave the house.
go in = đi vào; go on = xảy ra / tiếp tục; go back = quay về; go away = đi xa một thời gian; go out = tắt / ra ngoài.
Điểm ngữ pháp: go in = đi vào.
mcq.key: I know the house isn’t empty because I saw a man ___ about an hour ago.|go in

mcq.question: I don’t know what ___ in that classroom, but they’re making a lot of noise.
mcq.full: I don’t know what’s going on in that classroom, but they’re making a lot of noise.
mcq.vi: Tôi không biết chuyện gì đang diễn ra trong lớp đó, nhưng họ ồn lắm.
mcq.expl:
go in = enter; go on = happen / continue; go back = return; go away = leave home for a period; go out = stop shining / leave the house.
go in = đi vào; go on = xảy ra / tiếp tục; go back = quay về; go away = đi xa một thời gian; go out = tắt / ra ngoài.
Điểm ngữ pháp: go on = xảy ra.
mcq.key: I don’t know what ___ in that classroom, but they’re making a lot of noise.|’s going on

mcq.question: I’m sorry I interrupted you. What were you saying? Please ___.
mcq.full: I’m sorry I interrupted you. What were you saying? Please go on.
mcq.vi: Xin lỗi tôi ngắt lời. Bạn đang nói gì? Mời bạn nói tiếp.
mcq.expl:
go in = enter; go on = happen / continue; go back = return; go away = leave home for a period; go out = stop shining / leave the house.
go in = đi vào; go on = xảy ra / tiếp tục; go back = quay về; go away = đi xa một thời gian; go out = tắt / ra ngoài.
Điểm ngữ pháp: go on = tiếp tục.
mcq.key: I’m sorry I interrupted you. What were you saying? Please ___.|go on

mcq.question: He was born in Scotland, but it’s unlikely he ___ to live there because he’s lived in London for so long.
mcq.full: He was born in Scotland, but it’s unlikely he’ll go back to live there because he’s lived in London for so long.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy sinh ở Scotland, nhưng khó mà quay về sống ở đó vì đã sống ở London quá lâu.
mcq.expl:
go in = enter; go on = happen / continue; go back = return; go away = leave home for a period; go out = stop shining / leave the house.
go in = đi vào; go on = xảy ra / tiếp tục; go back = quay về; go away = đi xa một thời gian; go out = tắt / ra ngoài.
Điểm ngữ pháp: go back = quay về.
mcq.key: He was born in Scotland, but it’s unlikely he ___ to live there because he’s lived in London for so long.|’ll go back

mcq.question: I’m sorry, you can’t see the manager because he ___ on business for a few days.
mcq.full: I’m sorry, you can’t see the manager because he’s gone away on business for a few days.
